title: Deeper/broader IngeCAD LibreDWG patch-stack and route-specific writer evidence review
scope: IngeCAD's current LibreDWG vendor base and downstream patch provenance
Reconcile project-level R2000/R2004 writer claims with operation-specific disclosures
Map reported 2D DXF/DWG failure shapes to existing libdxfrw plan owners
Refine optional peer comparison readiness without expanding routine validation

method.kind: Read-only review of current public IngeCAD project and LibreDWG patch-log sources, plus local plan owner/receipt review
method.limitations: IngeCAD's patch log and project summary are mutable, maintainer-authored disclosures. Their private corpus, exact corpus manifest, converter binaries/build options, ODA artifact identity, and full semantic expected-value reports were not available or reproduced. Reported measurements are not libdxfrw results or support evidence.

sources.revision: mutable main; page labels 2026-09-27 base refresh and 2026-10-08 XREF update; read 2026-10-17
sources.observed: The log states the current vendor base is LibreDWG 0.14.8597 plus current/ingecad-vendor-0.14.8597.patch; it reports patched 0.14.8580-to-0.14.8597 read parity by entity result/count over 1,657 private corpus drawings, a 213-drawing save sweep opening in ODA and IngeCAD improving 182 to 185 with none worse, and make check 270/0. It describes fixes or candidate fixes for DIMENSION_ANG3PT import subtype matching, pre-R2007 codepage handling, FIELDLIST handles, proxy class/graphics/version fields, EED groups and signed values, annotative context export, and XREF BLOCK flags/path. These are maintainer-reported, route-specific observations.

The page reports 96.8% parity against ODA File Converter over 1,657 drawings and says a DWG round-trip fuzz harness plus fixes raised R2000/R2004 validity from 6% to 100%. The read review did not find a pinned corpus manifest, exact scoring definition, source/binary hash set, or operation matrix sufficient to reproduce those aggregates.
Used only as the upstream project identity referenced by IngeCAD's patch log. No upstream release, PR, or binary was installed or run in this review.

evidence.observed: The detailed patch log binds its stated vendor source to LibreDWG 0.14.8597 plus a carried patch file. It reports unchanged read entity results/counts across 1,657 inputs between patched 0.14.8580 and patched 0.14.8597, and a 213-drawing save sweep with 182-to-185 ODA/IngeCAD opens and no reported regressions.
doesNotEstablish: reproducibility without the exact corpus manifest, artifact hashes, arguments, and output reports
per-handle/type/owner or graph closure from aggregate counts or file-open results
current upstream LibreDWG behavior when the tested artifact includes downstream patches
any defect or support result in libdxfrw
evidence.planUse: At an already-scheduled optional comparison, record the exact upstream base/source SHA, patch file and PR-head digests, converter build, ODA identity, inputs, arguments, requested and actual AC codes, and per-source disposition. Preserve stock and patched outputs separately. Do not run corpus sweeps per implementation slice.

evidence.topic: R2004 write claim is operation and model-origin dependent
evidence.observed: The project page reports 100% validity for R2000/R2004 in a round-trip fuzz context. The detailed patch log says R2004 remains disabled for IngeCAD as a save target because a minimal DXF-authored model through dxf2dwg --as r2004 then dwg2dxf yields empty ENTITIES; it distinguishes this from a positive same-version dwgrewrite case on a DWG-decoded model. The sources therefore disclose at least two different operations/scopes rather than one universal writer result.
doesNotEstablish: which exact build or fuzz corpus underlies the high-level aggregate
that every R2004 writer path fails or succeeds
a local libdxfrw writer defect or support boundary
evidence.planUse: Qualify writer evidence by model origin, operation, and target version. For any relevant local R2004 change, use scratch-generated DXF-origin and DWG-origin controls, inspect actual magic, require an independent reader and native/audit result at the composed gate, and compare semantic identities.

evidence.observed: The patch log describes import/export defects around dimension subtype matching, legacy codepage strings in dictionary/table names, repeated FIELDLIST owner handles, proxy class identifiers and graphics placement/version, multiple APPID/EED groups and signed 1070/1071 values, annotative-context DXF output, and XREF metadata transfer from BLOCK to BLOCK_HEADER. Some counts are from IngeCAD's private corpus; one source note states ODA File Converter was used as a judge for particular outputs, without pinning its exact executable in the log reviewed here.
doesNotEstablish: one direction or version applying to all listed issues
independent ACIS/AcDs semantics, native platform qualification, or broad DWG/DXF parity
evidence.planUse: Route only relevant shapes to existing codepage, dimension, FIELD/FIELDLIST graph, EED/APPID, proxy, annotation-context, and XREF owners. When a local owner is next touched, use the smallest locally generated case with a suffix/owner sentinel. Add no duplicate finding or corpus-derived fixture.

evidence.topic: Downstream patch drift as a source of false attribution
evidence.observed: The patch log recounts a stale draft of LibreDWG #1375 in a vendor tree, a resulting pre-R2007 MTEXT corruption, and a subsequent correction after comparison with upstream stock. It states a vendor reconstruction rule based on exact PR heads rather than a developer work branch.
doesNotEstablish: that every vendor artifact has the same patch-state problem
that the historical downstream regression remains in the current vendor build
evidence.planUse: Before attributing a peer failure or porting a fix, distinguish release, exact upstream commit, and downstream patch stack; compare the tested build against its unpatched baseline and minimize only after provenance is captured.

existingOwnersOnly: existing EED/APPID/XDATA handle and signed-value owners
existing peer provenance and writer-version/operation matrix
